# Membrane FLV Plugin v0.13.1 - Table of Contents

> FLV Container implementation for Membrane Framework

## Pages

- [Membrane FLV Plugin](https://membrane-flv-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-flv-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.FLV](https://membrane-flv-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FLV.md): Format utilities and internal struct definitions for Membrane FLV Plugin

- [Membrane.FLV.Demuxer](https://membrane-flv-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FLV.Demuxer.md): Element for demuxing FLV streams into audio and video streams.
FLV format supports only one video and audio stream.
They are optional however, FLV without either audio or video is also possible.
- [Membrane.FLV.Muxer](https://membrane-flv-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FLV.Muxer.md): Element for muxing AAC and H264 streams into FLV format.
